research_question: Does sequence-aware modelling (LSTM/GRU) beat engineered trend features + Gradient Boosting for academic attrition prediction?
practical_significance: Sequence model (tcn) shows a directional advantage but the difference is NOT statistically significant (ROC-AUC p=0.6800, PR-AUC p=0.0840). Cannot reject the null hypothesis.
honest_assessment: IMPORTANT: These results are from SYNTHETIC data generated by a latent-process simulator. They demonstrate that the evaluation methodology is sound and the pipeline is end-to-end functional. They do NOT constitute real-world evidence for or against sequence-aware modelling. Final conclusions require evaluation on genuine institutional records.
